title: fix(cli): drop the gen audio --speed flag the API ignores
author: Drjacky

gist.summary: Removed `--speed` from `polli gen audio` because the `/audio` API ignored its `speed` query parameter; values from 0.25 to 4 previously returned unchanged audio without warning. The CLI now rejects the option before making a request, and its help no longer lists it. Added a rejection test and bumped `@pollinations/cli` to 0.1.35. This does not add audio speed support to the API.
